Image

Enhanced version of the img tag, providing multiple image fill modes, supporting loading prompts, and loading failure prompts. Width and height can be set through attributes.(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

Import

Currently, only manual import is supported, and the npm function is still in incubation.

"usingComponents": {
"maui-image": "../component/image/index"
}

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

The basic usage is the same as the native image tag, you can set src, and optionally set width and height, with default values of 320px and 240px respectively.

<maui-image width="100" height="100" src="https://img.yzcdn.cn/vant/cat.jpeg" />

2. Fill Mode

The image fill mode can be set through the mode attribute, with the available values listed in the table below.

<maui-image
  width="200"
  height="150"
  mode="center"
  src="https://img.yzcdn.cn/vant/cat.jpeg"
/>

3. Circular Image

The round attribute can be set to make the image round. Note that when the width and height of the image are not equal and the mode is aspectFit, it will not fill a complete circle.

<maui-image round width="350" height="150" mode="aspectFit" src=" https://img.yzcdn.cn/vant/cat.jpeg"></maui-image>

4. Loading Prompt

The Image component provides default loading and loading failure prompts.

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
src Image link String -
mode Image fill mode String aspectFill
width Width, default unit is px String / Number 320
height Height, default unit is px String / Number 240
radius Border radius, default unit is px String / Number 0
round Whether to display as a circle Boolean false
show-error Whether to display image loading failure prompt Boolean true
show-loading Whether to display image loading prompt Boolean true

Tips

  1. Either round or radius can be selected. When both attributes exist, the priority of radius is higher than that of round.

Image Fill Modes

Value Description
scaleToFill Scaling mode, does not maintain the aspect ratio, stretches the image's width and height to completely fill the image element
aspectFit Scaling mode, maintains the aspect ratio, ensuring that the long side of the image is fully displayed. In other words, the image can be completely displayed.
aspectFill Scaling mode, maintains the aspect ratio, only ensuring that the short side of the image is fully displayed. In other words, the image is usually complete in the horizontal or vertical direction, and cropping occurs in the other direction.
widthFix Scaling mode, width remains unchanged, height automatically changes, maintaining the original aspect ratio of the image
heightFix Scaling mode, height remains unchanged, width automatically changes, maintaining the original aspect ratio of the image
top Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the top area of the image
bottom Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the bottom area of the image
center Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the center area of the image
left Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the left area of the image
right Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the right area of the image
top left Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the top-left area of the image
top right Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the top-right area of the image
bottom left Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the bottom-left area of the image
bottom right Clipping mode, does not scale the image, only shows the bottom-right area of the image

Events

Event Name Description
bindclick Triggered when the image is clicked
bindload Triggered when the image is loaded
binderror Triggered when the image fails to load
